MathUtils¶

Git Source

Library for common mathematical operations used in DeFi protocols.

State Variables¶

WAD¶

Standard scaling factor (1e18) used for fixed-point arithmetic.

uint256 internal constant WAD = 1e18;

Functions¶

wadMul¶

Multiplies two WAD-scaled numbers with correct rounding.

Performs fixed-point multiplication using WAD (1e18 scaling) and applies rounding adjustment. The formula used is: `(x * y + WAD / 2) / WAD`, which ensures proper rounding.

function wadMul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256);

Parameters

Name

Type

Description

x

uint256

The first operand, scaled to WAD precision (1e18).

y

uint256

The second operand, scaled to WAD precision (1e18).

Returns

Name

Type

Description

<none>

uint256

The product of x and y, scaled back to WAD precision.

wadDiv¶

Divides two numbers while maintaining WAD precision.

Performs fixed-point division using WAD (1e18 scaling) with proper rounding. The formula used is: `(a * WAD + b / 2) / b`, which ensures accurate results.

function wadDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256);

Parameters

Name

Type

Description

a

uint256

The numerator, expected to be scaled to WAD precision (1e18).

b

uint256

The denominator, must be greater than zero.

Returns

Name

Type

Description

<none>

uint256

The quotient of a / b, scaled to WAD precision.

sqrt¶

Computes the square root of a given number.

Uses the Babylonian method for calculating square roots.

function sqrt(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint256);

Parameters

Name

Type

Description

x

uint256

The number to compute the square root of.

Returns

Name

Type

Description

<none>

uint256

The square root of x.
